title: How Much Weak Overlap Can Doubly Robust T-Statistics Handle?
abstract: arXiv:2504.13273v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Propensity scores near zero or one can make standard confidence intervals undercover. Econometric theory has targeted the Average Treatment Effect (ATE) under such weak overlap using nonstandard estimators or intervals. Practice has instead favored fixed thresholding rules that restore asymptotic normality by discarding extreme-propensity units for whom treatment may matter most. I show that standard t-tests for the ATE remain valid even when overlap is so weak that every regular estimator has infinite asymptotic variance. The key is to threshold the usual doubly robust estimator aggressively enough to control bias among unthresholded observations, but mildly enough to control bias from thresholding. I provide sufficient conditions for such thresholds to exist, and propose an adaptive rule of thumb to achieve coverage without knowing the weak overlap degree. translated_title: 双重稳健T统计量能应对多大程度的弱重叠？
translated_abstract: 倾向得分接近于零或一可能导致标准置信区间覆盖不足。计量经济学理论在此类弱重叠条件下，通过使用非标准估计量或置信区间来研究平均处理效应（ATE）。而实际应用中更倾向于采用固定阈值规则，通过剔除具有极端倾向得分的观测单位来恢复渐近正态性——然而这些单位恰恰可能是处理效应最为重要的对象。我证明，即使重叠弱到所有正则估计量都具有无穷渐近方差的程度，针对ATE的标准t检验仍然有效。关键在于对常用的双重稳健估计量施加阈值处理：既要足够激进，以控制未剔除观测中的偏差；又要足够温和，以控制由阈值化本身引入的偏差。我给出了此类阈值存在的充分条件，并提出了一种自适应的经验规则，使得在不知道弱重叠程度的情况下也能保证置信区间的覆盖率。在一个经典应用中，固定修剪剔除了18%的样本；而自适应……
tldr: 本文证明即使在重叠极其微弱、所有正则估计量渐近方差均无穷大的情况下，通过对双重稳健估计量施加强度适当的阈值修剪，针对平均处理效应的标准t检验依然有效，并提出了一种无需预知弱重叠程度即可保证置信区间覆盖率的自适应阈值规则。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that standard t-tests for the ATE remain valid even under extremely weak overlap—where all regular estimators have infinite asymptotic variance—by appropriately thresholding the doubly robust estimator, and proposes an adaptive rule of thumb that achieves valid coverage without knowing the degree of weak overlap.
